headline: Beat estimates; higher realization/volume drive performance

highlights: Per (%) -12/-13/-17 12M Avg Val (INR M) 266 Financial Snapshot (INR b) Y/E Mar FY26 FY27E FY28E Sales 90.1 102.0 110.2 EBITDA 14.4 14.2 17.5 Adj.

PAT was down 53% YoY at INR347m (vs. our estimated net loss of INR279m). ◼ Management indicated that sales volumes were significantly higher in the south region vs. east, which supported higher blended realization.

Capacity is targeted to reach 31mtpa by Mar’27, with Kolimigundala Line- 2 and clinker unit expected by Dec’26. ◼ We increase our EBITDA estimates by ~13%/10% for FY27/FY28E, considering improvement in profitability.
valuation: Capacity is targeted to reach 31mtpa by Mar’27, with Kolimigundala Line- 2 and clinker unit expected by Dec’26. ◼ We increase our EBITDA estimates by ~13%/10% for FY27/FY28E, considering improvement in profitability.
We value the stock at 13x FY28E EV/EBITDA to arrive at a TP of INR850.
watch: Capacity expansion to 31mtpa by Mar’27, Kolimigundala commissioning and further non- core asset monetization remain key monitorables. ◼ We estimate a CAGR of ~11%/10%/37% in revenue/EBITDA/PAT over FY26-28.
